name: Screen recording tutorial
description: Tightens a screen recording with narration (long waits trimmed, but pauses kept long enough to follow), then adds a result-first title, the presenter's name and an end card. A low music bed (when you supply music) is added. Cursor-driven zoom, speed-ups and step cards are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

variables.name: title
variables.label: The result, in one line
variables.example: Build a landing page in 10 minutes

beats.name: Show the result first
beats.guidance: Start with the finished result, then go back to step one.

beats.name: Steps
beats.guidance: One step at a time; keep the screen readable on a phone.

beats.name: Call to action
beats.guidance: Point to the file, template or next video.

effects.title: Low music bed
effects.description: Quiet music under the narration, lowered while someone speaks.

deferred.title: Cursor and click-driven zoom
deferred.description: Zoom glides to where the cursor clicks, with a click ripple. Zoom moves exist, but the editor has no cursor or click track yet.

deferred.title: Speed up dead waits
deferred.description: Speed up loading and waiting time.

deferred.title: Step captions and cards
deferred.description: Short step captions and Step N cards.

notes.text: Check the whole screen before you publish: notifications, email addresses, API keys, passwords and other people's data are easy to miss.

Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.

confirmations.ask: Is any private data, password, key or notification visible anywhere in the recording?
